description: Stage 1 (coarse grid) of the adaptive-density import sweep on the corrected model (#543 declared seeding, #547 incubation). Import count x Theta on the 20 matched covid_first_look_v4 fit seeds, index case infected at embarkation. Stage 2 (covid_import_sweep_v1r) is generated from this surface by tools/fit_covid_theta.py refine and inserts geometric midpoints only where P(takeoff) or the conditional onset medians move faster than the declared tolerances or cross the observed counts.
note: 5 Theta x 7 import counts x 20 seeds = 700 cells; roughly log-spaced imports. Theta brackets the v4 interior selection (3.16e7) by a decade each side. A screen, not a fit: imports is a declared axis and nothing here moves the scenario.
